# Fishing Teleports Randomly

Looking for a chaotic challenge? Every time you cast your line and hook something, you're not just getting loot—you're getting a one-way ticket to somewhere else!

This datapack turns every fishing trip into a random adventure. Hook a fish? ZAP! You've been teleported up to 1000 blocks away. It's the ultimate "Where am I now?" challenge.

## Features

- Instant Teleportation: Triggered the second your fishing rod hooks onto something
- Huge Range: Randomly spread within a 1000-block radius
- 1.21.11 Ready: Fully updated for the latest version of Minecraft with optimized code
- Multiplayer Friendly: Uses specific player targeting so only the person fishing gets teleported
- Lightweight: Clean logic that won't lag your server

## How to Play

1. Craft a Fishing Rod
2. Cast it into the water
3. Wait for a bite
4. As soon as you hook something... Good luck finding your way back!
